import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for plotting
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Create a bar chart to show the top products by sales
top_products = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_products.index, y=top_products.values)
plt.title('Top Products by Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a heatmap to show the distribution of customer age groups by product
age_group_counts = coffee_sales.groupby(['product', 'customer_age_group'])['total'].count().unstack().fillna(0)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.heatmap(age_group_counts, cmap='coolwarm', annot=True, fmt='d')
plt.title('Customer Age Group Distribution by Product')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Age Group')
plt.savefig('output_heatmap.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
